name: PM Ujjwala Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
description: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY) aims to safeguard the health of women & children by providing them with a clean cooking fuel – LPG.
eligibility: Adult woman belonging to a BPL family, SC/ST household, PMAY (Gramin), AAY, etc. No other LPG connection in the household.
benefits: Cash assistance of Rs 1600 for LPG connection and free first refill.
how_to_apply: Apply online on the official PMUY portal or submit the application at the nearest LPG distributor.

name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi
description: An initiative by the government of India in which all farmers will get up to ₹6,000 per year as minimum income support.
eligibility: Landholding farmers' families having cultivable land in their names.
benefits: Financial benefit of Rs 6000 per year in three equal installments of Rs 2000 each.
how_to_apply: Register on the PM Kisan portal with Aadhaar and bank details.

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: World's largest health insurance/ assurance scheme fully financed by the government.
eligibility: Families belonging to the SECC 2011 database under targeted categories (rural and urban).
benefits: Health cover of Rs. 5 lakhs per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.
how_to_apply: Check eligibility online and get the e-card at designated CSCs or impaneled hospitals.

name: PM Awas Yojana Urban
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: Provides housing for all in urban areas.
eligibility: EWS/LIG and MIG categories without a pucca house anywhere in India.
benefits: Credit linked subsidy on home loans, affordable housing in partnership.
how_to_apply: Apply online on the PMAY(U) portal or through CSCs.

name: PM Awas Yojana Gramin
description: Aims to provide a pucca house with basic amenities to all rural families who are homeless or living in kutcha or dilapidated houses.
eligibility: Houseless or households living in zero, one or two room houses with kutcha wall and kutcha roof as per SECC data.
benefits: Financial assistance of Rs. 1.20 lakh in plain areas and Rs. 1.30 lakh in hilly states.
how_to_apply: Identification is based on SECC 2011 data; approach the local Gram Panchayat.

name: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
description: Addresses the declining Child Sex Ratio (CSR) and related issues of women empowerment over a life-cycle continuum.
eligibility: Families with girl children.
benefits: Awareness campaigns, direct benefits to girl children for education and health.
how_to_apply: Implemented through district administrations, health centers, and schools.

name: National Scholarship Portal
description: A one-stop solution through which various services starting from student application, application receipt, processing, sanction and disbursal of various scholarships to Students are enabled.
eligibility: Students from minority communities, SC, ST, OBC, and general categories based on specific scheme guidelines.
benefits: Financial assistance for education (pre-matric, post-matric, higher education).
how_to_apply: Register and apply on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP).

name: PM Mudra Yojana
description: A scheme to provide loans up to 10 lakh to the non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises.
eligibility: Any Indian citizen who has a business plan for a non-farm sector income generating activity such as manufacturing, processing, trading or service sector.
benefits: Loans up to Rs 10 Lakhs without collateral.
how_to_apply: Apply through banks, NBFCs, MFIs or the Udyamimitra portal.

name: Atal Pension Yojana
description: A guaranteed pension scheme for citizens of India focused on unorganized sector workers.
eligibility: All Indian citizens between 18-40 years of age.
benefits: Guaranteed minimum monthly pension of Rs 1000 to Rs 5000 after 60 years of age.
how_to_apply: Approach the bank branch/post office where the individual's savings bank account is held.

name: PM Suraksha Bima Yojana
description: An accident insurance scheme offering accidental death and disability cover.
eligibility: People in age group 18 to 70 years with a bank account who give their consent to join.
benefits: Rs 2 lakh for accidental death and full disability; Rs 1 lakh for partial disability.
how_to_apply: Enroll at the bank branch or via internet banking.

name: PM Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
description: A life insurance scheme offering coverage for death due to any reason.
eligibility: People in age group 18 to 50 years having a bank account.
benefits: Life cover of Rs 2 lakhs at a premium of Rs 436 per annum.
how_to_apply: Enroll through the participating bank or post office.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
description: A small savings scheme backed by the Government of India targeted at the parents of girl children.
eligibility: Parents/guardians of a girl child below the age of 10 years.
benefits: High interest rate, tax benefits under section 80C, funds for girl's education and marriage.
how_to_apply: Open account at a post office or authorized commercial banks.

name: PM Fasal Bima Yojana
description: A comprehensive crop insurance scheme from pre-sowing to post-harvest.
eligibility: All farmers growing notified crops in a notified area.
benefits: Insurance cover and financial support to farmers in the event of failure of any of the notified crop.
how_to_apply: Apply through banks, CSCs or the national crop insurance portal.

name: Skill India PMKVY
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
description: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana enables a large number of Indian youth to take up industry-relevant skill training.
eligibility: School/college dropouts or unemployed youth.
benefits: Free skill training, certification, and placement assistance.
how_to_apply: Register at the nearest PMKVY training center or via the official portal.

name: Stand-Up India
description: Facilitates bank loans between 10 lakh and 1 Crore to at least one SC/ST borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch.
eligibility: SC/ST and/or women entrepreneurs, above 18 years of age.
benefits: Loans from Rs 10 lakh to Rs 1 crore for setting up a greenfield enterprise.
how_to_apply: Apply directly at a bank branch, SIDBI's Stand-Up India portal or through a lead district manager.

name: PM SVANidhi
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: A special micro-credit facility for street vendors.
eligibility: Street vendors engaged in vending in urban areas.
benefits: Working capital loan up to Rs 10,000, incentivization of regular repayment.
how_to_apply: Apply online at the PM SVANidhi portal or through CSCs.

name: PM Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
description: Scheme to supply free food grains to migrants and poor.
eligibility: Families holding ration cards under NFSA (Antyodaya Anna Yojana and Priority Households).
benefits: 5 kg of free food grains per person per month.
how_to_apply: Claimed automatically through fair price shops using a ration card.

name: Janani Suraksha Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: A safe motherhood intervention under the National Health Mission.
eligibility: Pregnant women from BPL households giving birth in government or accredited private health facilities.
benefits: Cash assistance to the mother for institutional delivery.
how_to_apply: Register with ASHA workers or local government health centers.

name: PM Scholarship Scheme
description: To encourage higher technical and professional education for the dependent wards & widows of CAPF & AR Personnel.
eligibility: Wards/widows of deceased CAPFs & AR personnel.
benefits: Scholarship amount of Rs 3000/month for girls and Rs 2500/month for boys.
how_to_apply: Apply through the National Scholarship Portal.

name: NREGA
description: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act guarantees the 'right to work'.
eligibility: Adult members of any rural household willing to do public work-related unskilled manual work.
benefits: At least 100 days of guaranteed wage employment in a financial year.
how_to_apply: Register at the local Gram Panchayat to get a Job Card.

name: Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana
ministry: Women and Child Development Department, Govt of Maharashtra
description: A state government scheme providing monthly financial assistance to eligible women to promote their economic independence and nutrition.
eligibility: Women aged 21 to 65 years, resident of Maharashtra, with a family annual income of less than Rs 2.5 lakh. Excludes income tax payers.
benefits: Financial assistance of Rs 1,500 per month directly transferred to the Aadhaar-linked bank account.
how_to_apply: Apply through the official Nari Shakti Doot mobile app or designated Setu Suvidha Kendras/Anganwadi centers.

name: Namo Shetkari Mahasanman Nidhi Yojana
description: A state scheme that supplements the PM Kisan Samman Nidhi by providing additional financial support to farmers in Maharashtra.
eligibility: Farmers holding agricultural land in Maharashtra who are already registered and eligible for the PM-KISAN scheme.
benefits: Additional financial benefit of Rs 6,000 per year (on top of the Rs 6,000 from PM-KISAN), paid in equal installments.
how_to_apply: Automatic enrollment for those successfully registered and receiving installments under the PM-KISAN scheme in Maharashtra.

name: Mukhyamantri Yuva Karya Prashikshan Yojana
ministry: Skill Development, Employment and Entrepreneurship Department, Govt of Maharashtra
description: A youth internship and skill training program to provide practical work experience and enhance employability.
eligibility: Youth aged 18 to 35 years who are residents of Maharashtra. Must have passed 12th grade, ITI, Diploma, or Degree.
benefits: Monthly stipend during training ranging from Rs 6,000 (12th pass) up to Rs 10,000 (Graduates/Post-graduates) for a 6-month duration.
how_to_apply: Register online via the Rojgar Mahaswayam web portal as a candidate seeking apprenticeship.
